text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the final screening for the URA 
poster models—the goal Kitasan Black and 
Satono Diamond had been aiming for—had 
finally arrived.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
It's finally today~ Hey, who do you think 
will get chosen?

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Crown and Duramente-san, right? They'd 
look so cool and striking as rivals!
choice_data_list:
(I wonder if those two are in their final 
interview right now...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan, relax, relax~ Don't be nervous, 
let's just be our usual selves!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
! Right... you're right. Deep breath in, 
deep breath out~!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Delight! We shall now commence the final 
screening interviews! Let us hear the 
golden words from you outstanding students 
chosen by the academy!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, please appeal your passion for 
the URA poster one by one in turn.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—And so, as stated in the submitted 
materials, if you select me as your model, 
I will be able to promote the URA far and 
wide.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Displaying posters across my father's 
establishments and affiliate stores will 
make them even more visible to the future 
stars who will carry the next generation.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Impressive! A presentation taking into 
account the very future of the horse girl 
world, truly magnificent!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I have proven my "strength" on the turf. 
Therefore, I have nothing further to state 
here.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Well, that is certainly true to 
your character. Now, next is—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's my turn! Dia-chan... let's go!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Hm? I believe I instructed you to present 
one by one?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
T-That's because our message can only be 
properly conveyed if the two of us are 
together!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... Intrigue! You seem to possess a 
distinct purpose, so let us hear it!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Yes, ma'am!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
In the world of racing where we compete, 
there is only winning or losing.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Everyone runs carrying their own dreams, 
elevating each other by competing—a world 
where everyone besides yourself is a 
rival.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
However, even if we are rivals, we believe 
that battling is not all there is...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Ever since we were little, we've 
encouraged and supported each other while 
chasing our dreams. That hasn't changed at 
all since entering Tracen Academy.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I felt discouraged or lost my 
way, remembering her gave me the resolve 
to keep trying! It brought out more power 
in me than ever!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because we have such a 
wonderful person by our side—that we can 
sprint toward our dreams with all our 
might!

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
That is why we want to grace the poster 
together!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Not with anyone else, but with 
Kita-chan—that's how we can convey this 
wonderful message.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
In a way different from Teio-san and 
McQueen-san. Because it's us, we can share 
the true wonder of the racing world...!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Magnificent! I have received your 
passionate feelings loud and clear!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
When you barged in to negotiate directly, 
I wondered what would happen—but that is 
not a bad answer at all.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wahhh~!! Look, our poster is already put 
up!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Look at that smile! You came out looking 
so good, Kita-chan~!
choice_data_list:
Congratulations once again on passing the 
model audition.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ehehe~, !

Well, I knew it would turn out like this 
right from the start♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My, my. Now who was it that was bawling 
their eyes out upon hearing the results, I 
wonder?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
M-More importantly! Congrats to both of 
you!! You should puff out your chests with 
way more pride, you know?!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, we're super happy, of course... but 
we can't let ourselves get complacent 
here!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes! To catch up to McQueen-san and the 
others as soon as possible, the two of us 
have to work even harder!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing their determination to move toward 
their next dream—made me look forward to 
what these two would achieve even more.
